ask: Tease the new packaging on Threads tomorrow, but blur the photo of the green box so people tap to see it: https://cdn.example.com/new-box.jpg

arguments.content: New box, same coffee. Tap to see it.

steps.why: The decision: spoiler media, because the reveal is the point and the image does the work; the text says what's behind the blur so the tap feels earned. It blurs images and videos only, so it needs the photo. Not a ghost post: the reveal should stay up.

say: Saved to Acme as a Threads draft: "New box, same coffee. Tap to see it." The photo is blurred until someone taps it. Nothing goes out yet. What time tomorrow?
